name.ja: ケロロ軍曹プラモコレクション　ギロロ伍長
name.en: Keroro Sergeant Plastic Model Collection Corporal Giroro

description.ja: 話題のＴＶアニメ「ケロロ軍曹」に登場するギロロ伍長のプラモデルです。
description.en: A plastic model of Corporal Giroro that appears in the popular TV anime "Keroro Sergeant".

description.ja: 手と足のパーツが複数付属し差替えで様々なパーツを再現可能です。
description.en: Multiple hand and foot parts are included, and various parts can be reproduced by replacing them.

description.ja: 目は回転式で表情が変化し、劇中で携帯したオプションパーツも多数付属しています。
description.en: The eyes are rotatable and their expressions change, and many of the optional parts that were carried in the play are also included.
